decisions.reason: The yogurt is very close to the core range and its award mention suggests credible early market acceptance, so it is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
This cheese was highlighted on the home page and presented as a focal product, which signals strategic importance and a very low likelihood of withdrawal within a year.
As a standard extension of the firm's established cheese offer in a growing market, it is more likely to be given time than removed quickly despite limited visible evidence of standout performance.
A spicy cheese line with several variants fits the firm's cheese competence and breadth strategy, so management would likely retain it unless sales clearly disappoint.
The mild creamy soft cheese was framed as completing the new assortment, indicating a deliberate portfolio role that supports keeping it on the market.

The washed-rind soft cheese is the most niche item among the launches and thus somewhat more at risk, but as it still builds on core dairy capabilities it would probably be kept for further market testing.
